scientific_integrity: Analytical all-parameter proof and separately reproducible exact-rational finite checks; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Independent homogeneous Bernoulli sources and perfect OR/leaf tests; per-building Bayes Hamming accuracy plus unthresholded coverage; not F1, concentration-threshold, or empirical detection. Historical priority not exhaustively established.
title: Sharp prevalence and coverage-weight thresholds for Bayesian source localization on a three-building wastewater junction
